## Contract seams — pin a contract before launching (GH-5)

These same-wave lanes are **write-disjoint but share a directory spine**, so they likely share
an interface (a not-yet-built module/schema). xyz is not for tightly-coupled work: pin a short
`CONTRACT.md` for the seam and point **each** lane's prompt at it (code TO the contract, not to
the other lane's source), or the split can stall when the consumer waits on the producer's handoff.

## How to fire a lane

Per lane, the existing pipeline applies — no new control plane:

```
.xyz/utils/swarm-preflight.sh --project-doc <PROJECT/**/doc.md>   # or --gh-issue N
   → ready packet (candidate/freshness/fix-still-required + lane assignment)
.xyz/relay-automation/marathon-drive.sh ...   # build→gate→review, contained
```

- **Lane scoping:** give each lane an `ALLOW_PATHS` matching only its zone above.
- If the lane's allowlist includes filesystem-touching `test/*.sh`, treat those tests as read-only specs in-turn; the outer harness gate verifies them after the turn, outside the isolated worktree.
